observations.title: Explain the two account-entry paths
observations.observed: Place an Order opens the e-Courier portal. Open an Account separately says a representative will provide a customer number.
observations.improvement: Add guidance for existing customers, new customers and urgent first-time deliveries. Explain how the customer number and portal login relate.

observations.title: Test a lighter first-contact path
observations.observed: The account form requires company, accounts-payable contact, and address details; it also presents optional fax and tax-ID fields.
observations.improvement: Discuss an essential-details delivery inquiry with billing setup later. Test completion and dispatch readiness before changing the workflow.

limitations: Portal entry was inspected without login or order placement. Tracking, account provisioning and delivery speed were not tested.
